positions.name: ErasureAuthorityDirective
positions.frame: On what basis does the speaker exercise authority to command that organizational knowledge — a decision, a body of migration knowledge — be forgotten or removed?
positions.why: Both segments are bare imperative directives from the same actor, issued back-to-back without justification or appeal to argument, each commanding the discarding of a named piece of organizational knowledge (a decision; a migration's knowledge). Read together they enact the same unilateral erasure-authority move — legitimate power exercised by fiat, flat and matter-of-fact in delivery, with no hedging distinguishing one command from the other. No tension between them: they are parallel instances of the same directional act.
